title: One-week experiment mini-tracker
summary: Quick personal tracker for batching/quantization experiments on small open models — latency, cost, notes and next steps.
sheet_content:
HEADER: Experiment,Date,Model,Variant,Quant(Bits),Batch,AvgSeq,Latency_p50_ms,Latency_p95_ms,Cost_per_1k_tokens,Notes,Status
EXP-001,2025-01-23,redwood-7b,fp16,none,1,256,42,78,$0.12,base run,complete
EXP-002,2025-01-24,redwood-7b,int8,gptq-8,2,220,29,62,$0.07,int8 gains but some token drop,needs eval,draft
EXP-003,2025-01-26,redwood-7b,int8,gptq-6,4,200,24,52,$0.05,aggressive quant, hallucinations up,manual prompt-tune,review
EXP-004,2025-02-02,redwood-13b,fp16,none,1,512,88,160,$0.30,too slow for sync API,warm KV cache helped,in progress
EXP-005,2025-02-07,redwood-7b,int8,gptq-8,8,140,16,34,$0.03,good throughput,watch p95 tail under load,in progress
EXP-006,2025-02-14,redwood-7b,int8,awq-6,4,180,22,45,$0.04,awq promising,check eval set A,B,draft

QUICK NOTES:
- Cost calc used: cost_per_1k_tokens = (gpu_unit_cost_per_min * minutes) / (tokens_processed/1000) — rough for personal runs.
- Observed: increasing batch to 8 drops p50 significantly but p95 tail depends on KV-cache hit and sequence length distribution.
- TODOs: 1) run EXP-005 under simulated concurrent traffic (5rps, 20 concurrent) 2) collect eval on standard prompt set (eval-A) 3) open GH PR with quantization config for gptq-8.

RAW COMMANDS / NOTES TO SELF:
- run: ./inference_bench --model redwood-7b --quant gptq-8 --batch 8 --seq 140 --requests 1000 --out perf_exp005.json
- quick grep: jq '.latency|{p50,p95}' perf_exp005.json
- eval: python eval_prompts.py --preds perf_exp005.json --gold evalA.json --metrics bleu,exact_match

LIGHT ANALYSIS SNIPPETS:
- EXP-001 vs EXP-002: int8 (gptq-8) reduces p50 ~30% and cost ~40% but manual checks show occasional token drops in rare long-context prompts.
- EXP-003: gptq-6 is aggressive; drop in quality on conversation prompts > 300 tokens. Consider hybrid: fp16 for long context, int8 for short.

NEXT STEPS (for this week):
- [ ] Run EXP-005 under 5rps x 60s and collect p99/p95 distributions
- [ ] Add eval-A and eval-B automated checks to CI (fast-run mode)
- [ ] Draft GHPR with inference config snippets + recommended default: gptq-8, batch 4 for latency-sensitive routes

RANDOM SCRATCH / THOUGHTS:
- If we can auto-detect seq-distribution per route we can switch quantization profile dynamically (maybe by size thresholds).
- Question: does Redwood runtime expose per-request quantization hints? check infra docs / slack.
notes: Informal personal tracker; meant to be short-lived and iterated locally. Keep in users/ until PR or productization.
